name: AlgMap-15.1
questiontext:
Solve the following quadratic equation by factorising: \[ {{CT:0}} = 0. \]

Write this quadratic in factored form: [[input:ansf]]\(=0\). [[validation:ansf]] [[feedback:fac]]

Solve this equation, giving your answer as a set \(\left(\mbox{e.g. }\left\{x_1 , x_2\right\}\right)\):

\({{CT:1}} \in \) [[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]][[feedback:prt1]]
generalfeedback:
There are multiple ways of solving quadratic equations but if you can spot how to factorise the quadratic then this method is by far the fastest and simplest. In this example we can factorise the quadratic to give: \[ {{CT:2}} = 0. \] Now, notice, that for the above equation to be equal to zero, the factors must be made to equal zero. So we find that: \[ {{CT:3}} = 0, \] or: \[ {{CT:4}} = 0. \] By rearranging these expressions we find that:
\({{CT:1}} = {{CT:5}}\) or \({{CT:1}} = {{CT:6}}\). Therefore our solution set is: \[ {{CT:1}} \in \left\{ {{CT:5}} , {{CT:6}} \right\}. \]
